key.name: split-condition
key.summary: When the menu and the page show side by side
key.description: An AdwBreakpoint condition on the window (adw_breakpoint_condition_parse syntax, e.g. "min-aspect-ratio: 4/3" for landscape, "min-width: 600sp"). While it holds, the menu is on the left and the page on the right; otherwise the menu opens the page full screen, with a back arrow. Empty: never side by side.

key.name: sidebar-width-fraction
key.summary: Menu width, as a fraction of the window
key.description: Side by side, the menu takes this fraction of the window's width, within the minimum and the maximum below.

key.name: sidebar-min-width
key.description: Side by side, the menu is never narrower than this.

key.name: sidebar-max-width
key.description: Side by side, the menu is never wider than this.

key.name: window-min-width
key.description: The window is never made narrower than this.

key.name: window-min-height
key.description: The window is never made lower than this.

key.name: last-page
key.description: The --page name of the menu entry opened last. Side by side, the app opens with it so the page pane is never empty (the menu's first entry when this is empty or no longer in the menu).
